messages.味方の攻撃に合わせて毎ターン「おい、下がれ」で追撃し、実質2回行動で火力を出す人: An Identity that follows up an ally's attack each turn with Hey, Back Off, effectively attacking twice. S3 Aiding Strike and defense's Protector's Stance build Poise to enhance every skill while also reducing damage taken.
messages.追撃: 常時発動パッシブ「君・可・傍・良」により、自分以外の味方のスキルが敵に当: **Follow-up**: Through the passive I.L.T.L.T. (I would've Liked to walk The Lord's path Together), which is always active, when another ally's skill hits an enemy, she makes a one-sided attack with Hey, Back Off at the end of that attack, once per turn. It also supplies Gloom resources every turn.
messages.呼吸で強化: 各スキルは呼吸威力と破裂威力の合計が6以上ならコイン威力+1(上位: **Poise bonuses**: Each skill gains +1 Coin Power if Poise Potency plus Rupture Potency totals at least 6 (+1 per 6, up to 2, at higher Uptie). Per the effect text, S1 counts "her own Poise Potency and Rupture Potency," while S2 and S3 count "her own Poise Potency and the target's Rupture Potency." She has trouble maintaining Rupture Count herself, so the condition is mainly met with Poise.
messages.護衛態勢: S3の使用時と守備「護衛」の戦闘開始時に2を得る(最大2、ターン終了: **Protector's Stance**: Gains 2 on using S3 and at Combat Start of the Defense skill Sentinel, up to 2, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. Damage taken is reduced by value×10%, and she gains Shield equal to her Poise at Turn Start, up to 20. At Turn End, she gains 3 Poise Potency and 1 Poise Count, and her leftmost slot gains +5 Aggro next turn.
messages.S3「加斥我援」: 使用時に呼吸3と呼吸回数3を得る。Ⅳコインは呼吸威力と対象の: **S3 — Aiding Strike [加斥我援]**: Gains 3 Poise and 3 Poise Count on use. Coin Ⅳ gains Critical damage based on her Poise Potency plus the target's Rupture Potency.
messages.呼吸の獲得: S1は使用時に呼吸回数1、S2「銘肌鏤骨」は使用時に呼吸回数2とⅡ: **Gaining Poise**: S1 grants 1 Poise Count on use, and S2 Engraved in Flesh and Bone [銘肌鏤骨] grants 2 Poise Count on use and Poise with Coin Ⅱ. Her Defense skill grants Poise equal to the target's Rupture on Clash Win, up to 5.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊侠」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 味方が倒れるか体力2: **Combat passive — Loyal Warrior (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When an ally falls or drops below 25% HP, she makes a one-sided attack with Aiding Strike against the enemy that made that attack, once per battle. The follow-up Hey, Back Off gains +30% Critical damage, and the 1 ally with the lowest SP recovers 2–4 SP.
messages.序盤にS3を使い、護衛態勢と呼吸で呼吸威力を早く6以上に乗せて、全スキルのコイン: Use S3 early to quickly push Poise Potency to 6 or more through Protector's Stance and Poise, raising the Coin Power of every skill. After that, just using the skills in hand lets her follow up every turn alongside allies' attacks. When Protector's Stance is about to run out, renew it with her Defense skill and cover allies with Aggro. She adds Rupture Potency but tends to reduce Count, so pair her with allies who can increase Rupture Count.
